tiers.name: RICH VEIN
tiers.tag: Dwarves will sing about this run.

tiers.name: GOLD RUSH
tiers.tag: The cart can barely carry it.

tiers.name: NICE HAUL
tiers.tag: A good day in the mine.

buys.name: Deep Shaft
buys.text: Ride straight into the Deep Shaft: 3 carts, 3 levels, and the multiplier never resets. Lose a cart to TNT and the next one replays the level.
buys.confirmText: DEEP SHAFT: 3 carts dive through 3 levels of richer gold. The multiplier and shields carry over; a crashed cart pays only its load and the next cart replays the level.

buys.name: Motherlode Run
buys.text: Skip the first level: start on level 2 with a x10 multiplier and 2 shield hats. Only the richest levels are left.
buys.confirmText: MOTHERLODE RUN: Deep Shaft from level 2, starting with a x10 multiplier and 2 shield hats.

intro.quote: "Hold your hat. It is a long way down."

outro.label: YOUR HAUL
outro.quote: "Daylight at last. The gold is yours."

fever.name: Twin Carts
fever.text: Pay 2.5x per ride: two carts run side by side on two tracks, both paid. Shields show up more often and Deep Shaft comes about twice as often. Stays on until you switch it off.
fever.onMsg: TWIN CARTS ON. TOTAL BET x2.5

features.title: GOLD, GEMS AND FORKS
features.text: Gold fills your load. Gems add 2 to 10 to the multiplier. At a fork the lever picks your side: rich or safe.

features.title: SHIELD HATS vs TNT
features.text: A shield hat takes one blast. Without one, TNT crashes the cart and you keep only your load.

features.title: DEEP SHAFT
features.text: Light 3 lanterns for 3 carts and 3 levels, a multiplier that never resets and a jackpot door at the bottom.

features.title: TWIN CARTS
features.text: Two carts, two tracks, both paid. Shields come more often and the shaft opens twice as often.
